图片 · 可保存原图: Image · Save the original to view
示例文件仅供预览: Sample file is for preview only
主机原文件保留 · 接收副本可另存: Host originals are kept · Save received copies as needed
上传者以实际连接 IP 标记: Uploaders are identified by their IP address
接收副本会一并清理；主机选取的原文件及上传设备原文件保留。: Received copies will be deleted. Originals on the host and uploading devices are kept.
只移除共享记录，主机原文件保留。: Remove sharing entries only. Original files on the host are kept.
连接中断，请确认主机仍在共享: Connection lost. Check that the host is still sharing.
正在上传，请完成后再添加文件: An upload is in progress. Add files after it finishes.
请在 Android APP 中使用本机打开: Open locally is available in the Android app
发送失败，请重试: Message failed to send. Try again.
每次最多打包 200 个文件: Select up to 200 files for each ZIP
预览模式请使用单个文件下载: Download files individually in preview mode
无法预览：格式不受支持、文件已移除或连接已中断。可保存原文件查看。: Preview unavailable. The format may not be supported, the file may be removed, or the connection may be lost. Save the original to view it.
请先连接正在共享的主机: Connect to a sharing host first
支持多个文件、图片和视频: Drop multiple files, images or videos
暂不支持文件夹，请选择文件: Folders are not supported. Select files instead.
请在 Android APP 中授权: Manage permissions in the Android app
请在 Android APP 中打开系统设置: Open system settings from the Android app
收到！我也分享一张喜欢的照片。: Got it! Here is a photo I like.
很好看，下次就去这里。: Looks great. Let’s go there next time.
连接同一 Wi-Fi，即可互传文件和文字。: Connect to the same Wi-Fi to share files and messages.
关闭共享后清理所有共享内容: Clear all shared content when sharing stops
开启后，关闭共享会清空文字、共享列表和 APP 内的接收副本。手机原文件及已另存: When enabled, stopping sharing clears messages, sharing entries and received copies in the app. Original and separately saved files are kept.
打开其他应用时，自动提供所选文件的临时读取权限。: Other apps receive temporary read access to the selected file.
接收设备连接同一 Wi-Fi 后扫码。: Connect the receiving device to the same Wi-Fi, then scan.
1. 所有设备连接同一 Wi-Fi，主机开启共享。: 1. Connect all devices to the same Wi-Fi and start sharing on the host.
2. 其他设备打开主机显示的地址。: 2. Open the address shown on the host from another device.
3. 用底部输入框发文字，点击「＋」发送图片或文件。: 3. Type a message below, or tap “+” to send images or files.
单击图片或视频可预览，视频支持播放与拖动进度。: Tap images or videos to preview. Videos support playback and seeking.
网址可点击打开，长按文字或链接可复制；安装 APK 时按提示授权。: Tap URLs to open them. Long-press text or links to copy. Follow the permission prompts when opening an APK.
点击顶部面板可收起共享信息；右上角「…」查看网络信息与文件列表。: Tap the top panel to collapse sharing info. Use “…” for network info and files.
接收文件保存在主机 APP 内，可另存到手机。关闭共享会清空文字；可在设置中选择: Received files are stored in the host app and can be saved separately. Stopping sharing clears messages; settings can also clear files. Removing a received file deletes its app copy. Each upload may be up to 2 GB.
同一网络内可下载文件、互发文字: Share files and messages on the same network
无法开启共享，请检查网络或端口是否被占用: Unable to start sharing. Check the network and whether the port is in use.
仅支持 http 或 https 网页链接: Only HTTP and HTTPS web links are supported
未找到可打开网页的浏览器: No browser is available to open this link
无法打开链接，请复制后使用浏览器打开: Unable to open the link. Copy it into a browser.
无法进入安装授权，请在系统应用设置中允许安装未知应用: Unable to open installation permissions. Allow unknown app installation in system settings.
没有可打开此文件的应用，可先保存到手机: No app can open this file. Save it to your device first.
无法打开文件，请重新添加或先保存到手机: Unable to open the file. Add it again or save it to your device.
安装 APK 需要允许 NoxShare 安装未知应用。授权返回后，将打开系统安: To install an APK, allow NoxShare to install unknown apps. Return here to continue to the system installation confirmation.
设置保存失败，请重试: Unable to save settings. Try again.
共享服务未响应，请关闭后重新开启共享: The sharing service is not responding. Stop and restart sharing.
未找到浏览器，请手动打开 http://127.0.0.1:8787: No browser found. Open http://127.0.0.1:8787 manually.
未授予安装权限，可在设置中重新授权: Installation permission was not granted. Try again in Settings.
保存未完成，请重新选择保存位置: The file was not saved. Select a location again.
部分接收文件未能清理，请在文件列表重试: Some received files could not be cleared. Try again in Files.
主机存储空间不足: The host is out of storage space
无法创建接收目录: Unable to create the receiving folder
无法保存接收文件: Unable to save the received file
文件名无效或过长: The file name is invalid or too long
主机正在接收其他文件，请稍后重试: The host is receiving other files. Try again shortly.
上传未完成，请检查主机存储空间后重试: Upload incomplete. Check the host’s free storage and try again.
接收副本暂时无法移除: Unable to remove the received copy right now
清理设置仅主机可用: Cleanup settings are available on the host only
